stemMd: A team must choose two people from Ada, Ben, Cora and Dan. Ada and Ben cannot both be chosen. If Dan is chosen, Cora must also be chosen. How many pairs are allowed?
explanationMd: The six pairs are Ada-Ben, Ada-Cora, Ada-Dan, Ben-Cora, Ben-Dan and Cora-Dan. Exclude Ada-Ben and the two Dan pairs without Cora. The valid pairs are Ada-Cora, Ben-Cora and Cora-Dan, three altogether.

distractorRationale.a: This misses one of the valid pairs involving Cora.
distractorRationale.c: This includes a pair violating one restriction.
distractorRationale.d: This removes only one of the forbidden pairs.
distractorRationale.e: This counts all pairs without restrictions.
